plan.failureSummary: Replay of cached page.ai instructions failed on an input step because the dynamic survey form shifted layout/fields (looking for 'Last Name' instead of 'Your Name').
observedIndicators: Failure occurred during deterministic replay inside the generated cache file (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js).
The cached step looked for 'Last Name *' input selectors ([data-testid='input-lastname'], placeholder 'Enter your last name').
The failure screenshot shows the current live form variant displays 'Your Name *' with placeholder 'Enter your name' rather than separate first/last name fields.
Heuristics indicate failureInCacheReplay=true, usedDeterministicMode=true, and isRetryAttempt=false.
Flow history shows frequent alternating runs between cached success and cache invalidation typical for shifting forms.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached page.ai instructions in .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js and trigger an automated retry with fresh autonomous exploration.

plan.notes: The unstable survey application randomly alters its form structure, labels, and question sets between loads. The deterministic cache replayed selectors for a previous layout variant, which failed against the live page. Clearing the cache allows autonomous execution to adapt to the current layout.
